description: This Java source file defines a LogWrapper class that implements the LogNode interface. It serves as a wrapper around Android's native Log utility, enabling logging with support for chaining multiple LogNodes. The class provides methods to set and get the next LogNode in the chain and to output log messages with proper handling of null messages and optional exceptions.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's Log utility and implements the LogNode interface to facilitate chained logging.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain where log data will be passed after this node.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs the log message using Android's native Log, handles null messages, and appends exception stack trace if provided; forwards the log to the next node in the chain.
